limitations: Temperature, top_p and top_k follow model-specific project defaults and are therefore not identical between Qwen and Gemma.
Memory and Life state persisted across conditions; per-turn snapshots are preserved in each response log, but there was no isolated baseline snapshot.
The prompt hash identifies the source file, not a separately versioned immutable prompt release.

GPT-OSS reasoning cannot be disabled on Groq; low effort with include_reasoning=false is the closest available setting. Its 1024-token completion budget includes internal reasoning and visible output, unlike the local 450 visible-token budget.
